newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish GPRD road builder IPO oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Polish GPRD road builder IPO oversubscribed.

text.p: Investors subscribed for 4,855,162 shares of Polish road builder Gdanskie Przedsiebiorstwo Robot Drogowych SA (GPRD) 2,248,700-share initial public offering, the company said in a statement on Monday.
It said the issue price was set at 11.2 zlotys, up from earlier set minimum issue price of nine zlotys.
It said the orders had been reduced by 90 percent.

GPRD, which seeks the main market's listing, made a net profit of 4.6 million zlotys last year on sales of 83 million zlotys and expects to earn a pre-tax profit of 10.3 million zlotys this year on revenue of 88.2 million zlotys.
